admin.settings.oauth_apps.title.description: Heading of the section of how apps may register on the server settings screen.

admin.settings.oauth_apps.description.defaultMessage: Which routes apps may use to get a client ID. With all of them off, only the server's own apps work. Turning one off does not disable the apps already registered.
admin.settings.oauth_apps.description.description: Explains the section of how apps may register.

admin.settings.oauth_apps.user.description: Checkbox of letting signed-in users register apps.

admin.settings.oauth_apps.user.descripti.defaultMessage: Signed-in users register apps in their settings, for bots and scripts of their own.
admin.settings.oauth_apps.user.descripti.description: Description of the checkbox of letting users register apps.

admin.settings.oauth_apps.metadata_docum.description: Checkbox of accepting apps whose client ID is the URL of a metadata document.

admin.settings.oauth_apps.metadata_docum.defaultMessage: Apps use the URL of a metadata document they host as their client ID. The server fetches the document.
admin.settings.oauth_apps.metadata_docum.description: Description of the checkbox of accepting metadata document apps.

admin.settings.oauth_apps.dynamic.description: Checkbox of letting apps register themselves.

admin.settings.oauth_apps.dynamic.descri.defaultMessage: Apps register themselves without signing in (RFC 7591), for tools that cannot use a metadata document.
admin.settings.oauth_apps.dynamic.descri.description: Description of the checkbox of dynamic client registration.

admin.settings.voice.title.description: Heading of the voice chat section of the server settings.

admin.settings.voice.starters.description: Label of the choice of who may start voice chat rooms.

admin.settings.voice.starters.everyone.description: Choice of who may start voice chat rooms: every local user.

admin.settings.voice.starters.everyone.d.defaultMessage: Every signed-in user of this server can start a room.
admin.settings.voice.starters.everyone.d.description: Explanation of the choice that every local user may start voice chat rooms.

admin.settings.voice.starters.permitted.description: Choice of who may start voice chat rooms: the holders of the permission.

admin.settings.voice.starters.permitted..defaultMessage: Only people whose roles have the permission to start voice chat rooms can start one.
admin.settings.voice.starters.permitted..description: Explanation of the choice that only the holders of the permission may start voice chat rooms.

admin.settings.voice.public_summary.defaultMessage: Show a summary of rooms to visitors
admin.settings.voice.public_summary.description: Checkbox of whether the summary of a voice chat room shows to people who are not signed in.

admin.settings.voice.public_summary.desc.defaultMessage: For a room open to everyone on this server, people who are not signed in and people on other servers see its name, description, host, and whether it is open, in link previews too. They never see who is in it.
admin.settings.voice.public_summary.desc.description: Explanation of the checkbox that shows the summary of voice chat rooms to visitors.

admin.settings.voice.retention.defaultMessage: Days to keep the participants' records
admin.settings.voice.retention.description: Label of the field of how many days the records of the participants of a voice chat room are kept.

admin.settings.voice.retention.descripti.defaultMessage: How long after a room ends the server keeps who joined, left, spoke, and was removed: {min} to {max} days. The records of a reported room stay as long as the report.
admin.settings.voice.retention.descripti.description: Description of the field of how many days the records of the participants of voice chat rooms are kept. {min} and {max} are the bounds.

admin.settings.voice.retention.invalid.defaultMessage: Enter a whole number of days from {min} to {max}.
admin.settings.voice.retention.invalid.description: Error of the field of how many days the records of voice chat participants are kept.

admin.settings.invites.title.description: Heading of the section of the invites that members create on the server settings screen.

admin.settings.invites.description.defaultMessage: Members create invites of their own on their settings page. The limits apply only to their invites, not to the invites of the moderators, and lowering one does not change the invites that exist.
admin.settings.invites.description.description: Help of the section of member invites on the server settings screen.

admin.settings.invites.creators.description: Label of the choice of who may create invites of their own.

admin.settings.invites.creators.everyone.description: Choice of who may create invites: every local user.

admin.settings.invites.creators.everyone.defaultMessage: Every signed-in user of this server who is not suspended or limited can create invites. While sign-ups need approval, the people they invite skip the review, so this lets every user approve new accounts.
admin.settings.invites.creators.everyone.description: Explanation of the choice that every local user may create invites, with its effect in the approval registration mode.

admin.settings.invites.creators.permitte.description: Choice of who may create invites: the holders of the permission.

admin.settings.invites.creators.permitte.defaultMessage: Only people whose roles have the permission to create invites can create them.
admin.settings.invites.creators.permitte.description: Explanation of the choice that only the holders of the permission create_invites may create invites.

admin.settings.invites.max_active.description: Label of the field of how many usable invites one member may hold at once.

admin.settings.invites.max_active.descri.defaultMessage: How many usable invites one person may hold at once: {min} to {max}. 0 lets nobody create invites.
admin.settings.invites.max_active.descri.description: Description of the field of how many usable invites one member may hold. {min} and {max} are the bounds.

admin.settings.invites.max_uses.description: Label of the field of how many people may sign up with one invite a member creates.

admin.settings.invites.max_uses.descript.defaultMessage: The most people who may sign up with one invite: {min} to {max}.
admin.settings.invites.max_uses.descript.description: Description of the field of how many sign-ups one member invite may allow. {min} and {max} are the bounds.

admin.settings.invites.number.invalid.defaultMessage: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
admin.settings.invites.number.invalid.description: Error of a field of the member invites that holds a number out of its bounds.

admin.settings.invites.max_expires_in.description: Label of the choice of how long one invite that a member creates may work at most.

admin.settings.invites.max_expires_in.de.defaultMessage: Members choose how long each invite works, up to this.
admin.settings.invites.max_expires_in.de.description: Description of the choice of how long a member invite may work at most.

admin.settings.landing.title.description: Heading of the section of the server settings about what the landing page (the root address, for people who are not signed in) shows.

admin.settings.landing.description.defaultMessage: What the page at this server's address shows people who are not signed in, besides the name, description and rules.
admin.settings.landing.description.description: Explanation of the landing page section of the server settings.

admin.settings.landing.counts.defaultMessage: Show the numbers of the server
admin.settings.landing.counts.description: Checkbox of whether the landing page shows how many members the server has, its public posts of the last 7 days, and since when it runs.

admin.settings.landing.counts.descriptio.defaultMessage: How many members the server has, how many public posts they made on each of the last 7 days, and since when the server runs. Only public posts count, and the numbers are refreshed every few minutes.
admin.settings.landing.counts.descriptio.description: Explanation of the checkbox that shows the numbers of the server on the landing page.

admin.settings.landing.operators.description: Checkbox of whether the landing page lists the people who run the server.

admin.settings.landing.operators.descrip.defaultMessage: The accounts of this server that show the badge of a staff role (administrator, moderator, or a role with moderation or server permissions) on their profile, with their badges. A staff member who does not show their badge is never listed.
admin.settings.landing.operators.descrip.description: Explanation of the checkbox that lists the people who run the server on the landing page.

admin.settings.featured.title.description: Heading of the section of the server settings about the accounts suggested to follow.

admin.settings.featured.description.defaultMessage: New and returning users see suggestions of people to follow: the accounts below first, in this order, then the people of this server who posted recently. Someone who turned off being suggested is left out.
admin.settings.featured.description.description: Note of the suggested accounts section of the server settings.

admin.settings.featured.accounts.description: Label of the field with the usernames of the accounts that the suggestions show first.

admin.settings.featured.accounts.descrip.defaultMessage: Usernames of up to 20 accounts of this server, separated by spaces.
admin.settings.featured.accounts.descrip.description: Help text of the field of the accounts that the suggestions show first.
